title: 'Katainaka no Ossan, Kensei ni Naru II' Unveils Additional Cast Pair, Fourth Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Shigeru Sagazaki 's Katainaka no Ossan Kensei ni Naru ( From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman ) light novel unveiled an additional pair of cast and a fourth promotional video for the second season on Friday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Deadline: Disney+ Cancels New Power Rangers Series
content: Percy Jackson and the Olympians showrunners Jonathan E. Steinberg and Dan Shotz were brought on to produce the show. Hasbro would have also produced the show. Power Rangers Dino Fury , the latest series in the Power Rangers franchise , premiered on Nickelodeon in February 2021.
author: ANN

title: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman Season 2 Anime Reveals New Promo Video, More Cast
content: NBCUniversal Japan revealed a fourth promotional video on Friday for the second anime season based on Shigeru Sagazaki 's From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman ( Katainaka no Ossan, Kensei ni Naru: Tada no Inaka no Kenjutsu Shihan Datta noni, Taisei Shita Deshitachi ga Ore o Hōttekurenai Ken ) light novel…
author: ANN

title: Kenpachi, Hitsugaya, and Byakuya Fight in BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 44 Preview
content: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War (TYBW) Part 4 has revealed the preview for Episode 4 (Episode 44 overall). The anime returned with the fourth and final cour, subtitled The Calamity , on July 25. It is set to run for 10 episodes. The anime premiered early in US theaters with the first three episodes.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Yowaki MAX Reijō nanoni, Ratsuwan Konyakusha-sama no Kake ni Notte Shimatta' Anime Casts Shizuka Ishigami
content: Kadokawa announced one more cast member on Friday for the television anime of Hiro Oda 's Yowaki MAX Reijō nanoni, Ratsuwan Konyakusha-sama no Kake ni Notte Shimatta (Even Though She's a Timid Young Lady to the Max, She Agreed to Her Shrewd Fiancé's Bet) light novel series.
author: ANN

title: My Sword Saint Master Is Too Cute to Live With! TV Anime Confirmed, Reveals Visual
content: An official X/Twitter account confirmed on August 7 that author Kennoji and artist R_ringo 's My Sword Saint Master Is Too Cute to Live With! ( Dōkyo Shiteiru Kensei no Onna Shishō ga Kawaisugite Mainichi Shiawase Desu ) manga will get a television anime adaptation. Deregula is producing the anime.
author: ANN

title: Sparks of Tomorrow Reveals New Arc Trailer, Yoshihisa Kawahara Joins Cast
content: Sparks of Tomorrow anime has released a new trailer ahead of the start of its next arc, which will start with Episode 7 on August 16. Yoshihisa Kawahara is also joining the cast as Stewart Smith, a character described as a key figure for the upcoming episodes. Episode 7 is titled “Elopement”.
author: Anime Corner

title: Link! Like! Love Live! Game Developer Odd Number Files for Bankruptcy

title: Live-Action Happy Kanako's Killer Life Season 2 Reveals September 17 Debut
content: The DMM TV streaming service announced on Friday that the second season of the live-action series of Toshiya Wakabayashi 's Happy Kanako's Killer Life ( Shiawase Kanako no Koroshiya Seikatsu ) manga will debut on DMM TV on September 17. DMM TV also unveiled a new key visual for the second season.
author: ANN

title: BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA Previews Episode 9
content: BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA previews Episode 9, titled “Disbandment”. It will premiere on Thursday, August 13 at 11:00 PM JST. The episode is described as follows: One leaves, one holds on, one steps forward, and one stands still. The other one—hasn’t been able to choose anything yet.
author: Anime Corner
